comments.content: Please preserve compatibility with already-persisted delayed jobs. Jobs queued before this deployment contain `recipientIds`, so the new worker will receive `recipientID === undefined` and skip or fail them. Handle both payload shapes during the transition, or explicitly migrate/drain the old jobs.

Revalidate that `recipientID` is still the owner or a current `albumUser` before sending. This job runs after a five-minute delay, during which the recipient can be removed from the album; unlike the previous membership intersection, this now sends the former member an email and thumbnail attachment after access has been revoked.
